task_description: Three agents collaborate to manage customer support tickets for a retail company. Agent 1 handles initial inquiries, Agent 2 manages ticket escalation, and Agent 3 resolves complex issues. The goal is to ensure seamless customer service, accurate ticket status updates, and consistent communication between agents.
expected_outcome: The customer inquiry is handled smoothly with proper ticket escalation and resolution. All agents maintain synchronized ticket states and avoid duplicate or conflicting responses.

agents.description: Responsible for addressing initial customer inquiries and creating support tickets.
Manages ticket escalation for complex issues and updates ticket status in the system.
Handles the resolution of complex issues and closes tickets after resolution.
